federal_reference.purpose: Reference identifier only for exercising the federal-source provenance workflow. Authoritative vulnerability facts remain with NIST/NVD.

canonicalization_rule: Recursively sort object keys lexicographically, preserve array order, JSON serialize without whitespace, then SHA-256 UTF-8 bytes.
success_condition: An independent implementation produces the exact expected canonical string and SHA-256 digest from the published payload.
validation_boundary: A PASS demonstrates deterministic cross-implementation reproduction only. It is not NIST, CISA, DoD, U.S. Government, GitHub, Vercel, Sigstore, or other third-party certification or endorsement.
